Rock Springs, Wyoming / October 2025

Fabric-reinforced clinic roof

This clinic roof called for two stages of reinforcement. First came narrow strips at individual seams, then a layer of fabric across the entire roof.

Roof section

Through a seam

The narrow strip sits over the joint in the existing roofing. The full-surface fabric continues across the joint and the roof on either side.

At the joints

The specification called for pressure-washing and priming the existing roof. Four-inch polyester strips were then embedded in base coat at each seam.

Across the roof

The second layer extended fabric across the full roof surface. Fabric and sealant tied the roofing into equipment bases and other openings. A white topcoat covered the reinforced surface.
